name: ETL Amazon Seller Central To Azure Synapse Analytics
steps:
1.  From the DataSources section select Amazon Seller Central as the data source.
2.  Select your added Azure Synapse Analytics data warehouse as the data destination. If you have not yet added a data warehouse, go to [Data Warehouse](https://console.datachannel.co/datawarehouse) tab and add a warehouse.
3.  Authorize DataChannel to connect to your Seller Central account. With your **Seller Name** & **Marketplace**, use OAuth, similar to the process described in this [Documentation](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/set-up/authentication.html#_connecting_using_oauth) page.
4.  Click on [\+ Data Pipeline](https://console.datachannel.co/datasource/amz-seller-central/report/new) to start adding data pipelines to your account.
